summary: Halifax Stanfield International Airport is Atlantic Canada's largest and busiest airport, located in Enfield, Nova Scotia, approximately 33 km northeast of downtown Halifax. Originally opened in 1960 as Halifax International Airport, it was renamed in 2003 in honour of former Nova Scotia Premier Robert Stanfield. The modern single-terminal facility serves as a key gateway to the Maritime provinces and a connecting hub for transatlantic flights to Europe.
